Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md:3880:**File claims.** A claim warns and sequences agents. It is not a FileSafe lock or a lease. Paths are normalized as Gap #34 requires, into the `path_ref` and `path_hash` that SP-320 defines. A newer claim by the same agent on the same `path_hash` supersedes the older one. A claim ends only when the agent's terminal event is applied; heartbeat expiry reaches the claims only through `coordination.agent_crashed` with `heartbeat_expired`. There is no release value. Gap #31's git diff validation runs before the agent's terminal event. A mismatch found later is logged and appends nothing.
